verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's own registered agent service documents electronic receipt of legal documents with phone notification when service of process arrives. Its API also exposes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints. The evidence does not say documents are accepted at a physical street office or scanned into the account the same day they arrive. Missing for 10: evidence of a real staffed street address accepting service, a same-day scanning/upload commitment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received

citations.quote: Receive critical legal documents electronically and be notified by phone when you receive service of process, ensuring you never miss a document.
Instantly access state forms pre-filled with our registered agent address for simplified filing.
